overview: A secret and sweet real-life romance between veteran academy instructor Seo Hye Jin and her flirty student Lee Joon Ho, who returns after 10 years and stirs her heart.
title: The Midnight Romance in Hagwon

overview: Originally a suspense anthology, the show eventually became focused solely on the adventures of a one-armed private detective based in London.
title: The Vise

overview: The story follows Li Shande, a man deceived by his colleagues and demoted from his supervisory role. Now forced to become the "Lychee Envoy," he faces a near-impossible mission to deliver fresh lychees from Lingnan to Chang'an as a birthday gift for the Noble Consort. The saying goes that lychees change color in one day, lose their fragrance in two, and their flavor in three days. With more than 5,000 li between Lingnan and Chang'an, and under tight deadlines with limited resources, how can he possibly pull it off?
title: The Litchi Road

overview: Liu Chang Sheng is a beautiful princess from Fuyu. She is optimistic, cheerful, quick-witted and has a sharp tongue. Since childhood, she reads poetry and books, understands righteousness, and aspires to become a woman who does not lose to men. However, she causes strange bad luck to men who comes near her. They would get either drowned or get their leg broken. This makes it difficult for her to get married as most men rejects her.
title: The Unexpected Marriage

overview: In the late 1990s, Liu Jun who studied in Germany returns to his hometown of Donghai. Following the tide of the times, he is determined to modernize his father's old machinery factory with leading technology. As a private enterprise, Liu Jun struggles to acquire capital, connections, and technology.
title: Created in China

overview: Two girls, Cai Xiao'ai, who is battling a terminal illness, and Gu Eun Zhao, a cold and distant girl, come together despite their fates. As they struggle with life's challenges, friendship, family, love, and their future, a hidden conspiracy begins to unravel around them.
title: Girls, Let's Defy Fate

overview: "I'm into someone." Cang Shu, a straight-A student who always indulges in learning and has no passion for social contact, actually announces in public that she likes the poor student Qi Lin?! Thanks to a misunderstanding, the two of them begin to get to know each other. When a girl who disdains to make friends meets another girl who desires to be loved, what will occur between them?
title: She Is Still Cute Today

overview: Whatever, Whenever promises to fulfill any wish, at any time, for just $9.90 and a task: help with someone else's wish, whatever it may be.
title: Desejos S.A.

overview: The story follows police officer Wen Binbin, who, with the support and assistance of team leader Xing Liang, embarks on a determined journey to find his lost service pistol. Despite numerous challenges, he remains steadfast in his pursuit of the truth and eventually captures the mastermind behind the scenes.
title: Black & White Forest

overview: Deng Yan accidentally disrupts a police operation while rescuing a trafficked girl and becomes the new anti-trafficking office director. Chang Rui, a former undercover detective, is initially unhappy with her lack of experience. However, Deng Yan proves her abilities and earns his respect. Despite personal challenges, Chang Rui reaffirms his commitment to combating human trafficking. Driven by the disappearance of a childhood friend, Deng Yan uses new technology to solve old cases. As she uncovers a large trafficking network, she feels increasing responsibility. Despite facing dangers and crises, she persists in seeking the truth. After clearing her name, she leads her team against the trafficking ring's powerful forces.
title: Sword Rose

overview: Young and idealistic Liu Ziming joins a police division to fight crime, only to find routine investigative work far duller than expected. But as he gains field experience, he grows into a shrewd detective, mentoring newcomers while solving complex cases. Through many investigations, Liu confronts humanity's duality-the good and evil within-evolving into an exceptional captain. His mentor and comrades teach him the weight of a detective's duty. Now, safeguarding justice becomes his pride.
title: Into the Heat

overview: In 2002, newly graduated An Yan was assigned to teach at Heping Middle School in Changzhi County. Initially struggling to adapt to the rural environment and educational philosophy, she gradually came to value the significance of rural education and the sense of "being needed" through her interactions with students and home visits. Inspired by former principal Yu Tian and current principal Fu Shengzhi, An Yan embraced and carried forward the educational principles of "preservation" and "nurturing," becoming a well-regarded teacher. By 2012, An Yan had advanced to vice principal, overseeing logistics and successfully implementing the "nutritional lunch" program. In 2016, she was appointed principal of a relocated poverty alleviation school. Despite facing challenges with a weak teaching foundation and complex student backgrounds, An Yan and a team of dedicated rural teachers tackled each issue, creating a quality learning environment for the students. Like An Yan, rural educators tirelessly work to help students from mountain villages reach new heights.
title: Sowers of Hope

overview: Following professional truckdrivers around the clock delivering different types of cargo across the county - north to south
title: Svenska Truckers

overview: Six college students with contrasting personalities begin an internship at a senior care community. Through close interactions and daily observations, their preconceptions about aging are challenged as they discover the residents' enduring vitality, surprising perspectives, and wealth of life experience, along with a playful, childlike spirit. Over one semester, their views transform, and they become true "across‑age friends" to the community's beloved grandparents.
title: Young Again

overview: In 494 B.C., the Kingdom of Wu defeated the Kingdom of Yue. King Goujian of the Kingdom of Yue became a slave and was humiliated for three years in the Wu Palace. After returning to his kingdom, Goujian endure countless hardship, utilized loyal talents Wen Zhong and Fan Li, and fought to revive the kingdom. Wen Zhong presented "Nine Strategies to Bring Down Wu". And Xishi, an ordinary washer girl bid farewell to her lover Fan Li and went to Wu with the intention of not being a conquered people. While the King of Wu, Fuchai and the ministers were wary of Goujian and repeatedly tested him, Xishi was always able to notice and warn them. She cooperated with Fan Li and the others, so that they could survive the danger. While the Kingdom of Yue was secretly gathering popular support, the Kingdom of Wu was instead boasting of its achievements, colonizing infinitely, and the power of the two kingdoms had become evenly matched. Goujian finally seized the opportunity as Fuchai fought for hegemony north to Huangchi, to conquer the Kingdom of Wu's capital Gusu and bring about the revival of the kingdom. Deferring to history, the story also tells the legend of Xishi and Fan Li's romance and sacrifice for the sake of the kingdom.
title: The Tale of Xishi: Kingdom Rebuilt

overview: It's a story about Cao Yanbing, the descendant of Cao Cao, strong as the God of War, Xia Ling, who has a mysterious guardian spirit following her, and Beiluo Shimen, the former Spirit-Subduing General, going to the Forest of Emptiness to find the ancient Luhua Building with different agendas. It is a dangerous journey, but they support each other, overcome difficulties together, and finally become mature. However, they also find some shocking secrets...
title: Hero is Back

overview: The young man from the small town, Tao Wujie, was accepted into the Binjiang branch of Shenmao Bank, starting from the very bottom as a teller. His girlfriend, Tian Xiaohui, a Shanghai girl, entered a trust company through the introduction of her cousin. The two vowed to make great strides in the financial industry and strive to establish themselves in Shanghai as soon as possible. Tao Wujie, diligent and capable, stood out and was spotted and carefully mentored by the branch manager Zhao Hui and the audit director Miao Che, gradually finding his purpose and direction in his banking work; while Xiaohui, after entering the trust capital, brutally fought for survival, climbing up step by step only to discover that in this world of money, the two faced various challenges and tests. Wujie and Xiaohui, Zhao Hui and Miao Che, two generations of financial workers in the city, experienced career choices and fluctuations in fate. Facing temptations and dilemmas, they needed to make choices time and again: to go with the flow or to remain true to their original aspirations and end well?
title: City of the City

overview: Just Hope is a melodrama about a mother of 3 children who, due to the start of a full-scale war, is forced to leave her home for the sake of her family's safety. In a difficult time, without the support of her husband and money, she moves to another city, where she starts a new life and takes the first steps towards realizing her dream - to become a successful baker-confectioner.
title: Просто Надія

overview: Cult Justice explores the magnetic power of criminal cult leaders—and the dramatic investigations that finally brought them to justice.
title: Cult Justice

overview: Manow was born into a wealthy family, but she got kidnapped as a baby by her aunt who was jealous that she'll receive the majority of the inheritance. She left Manow in the slums and was about to kill her when Jarunee found them. The aunt left in a hurry. Jarunee then took the baby as her own and raised her. Years later, Manow works in several jobs in order to feed her family. When fate leads her to meet Suruk, a millionaire, they don't get along at first but they eventually fall in love. Will he be able to find her biological parents?
title: Leh Nang Hong

overview: Detectives Anis Don Demina, Kristina "Keyyo" Petrushina, Morgan Alling, Arantxa Álvarez, Nassim Al Fakir, Nisse Hallberg and Sussie Eriksson are faced with clever assignments. Who will do best and be crowned this year's master detective?
title: Detektiverna

overview: Tiraka is a dangerous woman who can do anything to be the princess of the prestigious and enchanting Sang Soon Palace. She gets engaged to the heir of Sang Soon, Prince Aysoon Suriyachat, or "Thong". The engagement enrages Prince Pasaworn Suriyachat, or "Thoi", the jealous twin brother of Prince Aysoon, who feels that Tiraka is rightfully his.
title: Saeng Soon

overview: Anders Ankan Johansson and Valle Westesson buy cars for a maximum of 10,000 bucks and drive them to the place where they were once built.
title: Rostiga roadtrips

overview: They rescue seriously injured accident victims from wrecked cars and battle blazing flames. The emergency responders at the fire stations in Iserlohn, Lünen, Dresden, Potsdam, Hildesheim, and Chemnitz must work with absolute concentration, because in acutely dangerous situations, every mistake can have fatal consequences. The series follows the lifesavers in their strenuous daily work. Body cameras capture critical situations from the firefighters' perspective. This perspective provides a particularly realistic portrayal of dramatic events, such as extinguishing a fire in a smoke-filled apartment.
title: 112 Feuerwehr im Einsatz

overview: Comedy and variety show which also features Russ Abbot and Bella Emberg
title: Freddie Starr Variety Madhouse

overview: Original Morecambe and Wise show which aired on the ITV Network between 1961 and 1968.
title: Two of a Kind

overview: A love triangle from a past life is set to happen again in this life. Praewa is a creative girl with high determination in her work. When she meets Peem, a rising young model, she was struck by his face from the moment she saw his photo. She felt connected to him, like they've known each other before. Praewa offers to be the one to conceptualize the album for Peem. She also received an appointment from the owner of the cable TV that Peem signed a contract with to go watch him at the hotel. When she arrived, Praewa met Nin, who was a fan of Peem.
title: Raeng Rit Pit Sawad

overview: A former outlaw and big-hearted father, Castaneda has not always been on the good side of life. Today he has only one goal: to give the best to his daughter. But when his daughter disappears, he breaks the rules to find her. The first hours are decisive and the police stations are understaffed so Castaneda will investigate in his own way: surrounded by people like him, anonymous people, without privileges or diplomas, they will crisscross the countryside to track down the kidnapper.
title: Brigade anonyme

overview: The Invisible Shield, a four-part documentary series, reveals a little-known truth: that public health saved your life today and you probably don't even know it. But while public health makes modern life possible, the work itself is often underfunded, undervalued, and misunderstood.
title: The Invisible Shield

overview: Next Baking Master: Paris gives ten ambitious and highly-skilled American bakers unprecedented access to the most iconic pastry shops, as well as mentoring from renowned French baking experts. The series demands that competitors prove their mettle in the pillars of great baking and pastry: technique, artistry, flavor, innovation, and inspiration. Each week, the lowest performing baker will be sent home -- until only one is named Next Baking Master.
title: Next Baking Master: Paris

overview: Sanford Arms was a spin-off comedy series from Sanford & Son. Fred and Lamont had moved to Arizona and they sold their property to Phil Wheeler. Phil now lives in the Sanfords' old house with his two teenage children, Angie and Nat. The primary setting of the series, however, was the rooming house next door which Fred named "The Sanford Arms". Most of the recurring characters from the original series also starred in this series. Grady was now married to his girlfriend Dolly. Bubba now worked at the Sanford Arms as a bellboy and a maintenance man. Aunt Esther was left in charge helping Phil and collecting the mortgage payments. Rounding out the cast of characters was Phil's girlfriend, Jeannie.
title: Sanford Arms

overview: In his latest epic adventure, Michael Palin embarks on a 1300-mile journey across Nigeria. Known as ‘The Giant of Africa', within 50 years Nigeria will be the third most populated country in the world after India and China. And while claims of corruption and fraud have blighted the country he also finds a very different Nigeria - stunning nature, diverse cultures and fascinating people. From the chaotic energy of Lagos to Islamic history in Kano and the tropical landscapes of the south, yet in some areas the spectre of terrorism remains. For Michael, at 80 years old, it may well turn out to be the most prophetic journey of his life.
title: Michael Palin in Nigeria

overview: Series exploring the weird history, weird legends and weird locations of the UK.
title: Weird Britain

overview: Every fight can be make or break. Take a ringside seat at the McGuigans' boxing stable – where discipline, dedication and determination are the route to the top.
title: Stable: The Boxing Game

overview: This two-part series follows the late Paul O'Grady as he travels through Thailand and Laos to celebrate the wonderful work done by elephant conservation centres to rescue, rehabilitate and protect these most majestic, but vulnerable, of animals. Filmed in the months before his sudden and unexpected death, this was Paul's final TV project and one that he was incredibly passionate about. Thailand has the largest number of elephant rescue centres in the world, while Laos is nicknamed the ‘land of a million elephants', and in each episode, Paul travels across the region to roll up his sleeves and muck in to help out at a different rescue centre. Along the way, Paul also heads out from the sanctuaries to grab a slice of local life by exploring nearby colourful markets, temples and apothecaries and trying local cuisine. The series highlights challenges faced by elephants in the region and as ever, Paul's love for animals shines throughout. The tone is warm, playful and heartfelt and always characterised by his much-loved wit and humour.
title: Paul O'Grady's Great Elephant Adventure

overview: TNT TV channel is reinventing the format of the morning program. Every morning on weekdays from 7 to 9 a.m., the audience will be greeted by presenters Anna Khilkevich and Anatoly Tsoi, as well as their guests. The project "MORNING. TNT is designed to become the most useful and modern morning on Russian television, because it will reflect all current and popular trends, topics and agendas. TNT will create a unique mix of television and digital, in which there will be a place for both TV masters and fresh faces. Communication with guests, capacious and modern headings, riles, shorts and telegram posts in a new format – all this is "MORNING. TNT." The leading columns in the new show will be writer and journalist Sergey Minaev, psychotherapist Andrey Kurpatov, chef Mirko Dzago, powerlifter and world record holder Kirill Sarychev, oncologist Alexander Dzidzaria and many others.
title: Утро ТНТ

overview: A poor boy named Tom Canty and Edward, the Prince of Wales exchange identities but events force the pair to experience each other's lives as well.
title: The Prince and the Pauper

overview: The Liver Birds is a British sitcom, set in Liverpool, North West England, which aired on BBC1 from April 1969 to January 1979, and again in 1996. The show was created by Carla Lane and Myra Taylor. The two Liverpudlian housewives had met at a local writers club and decided to pool their talents.
title: The Liver Birds

overview: Lily is the daughter of a rich businessman. She meets Witsarut and falls in love with him. She then pretends to be poor and rents a room from Witsarut and his friends. She tells Witsarut her name is Plub Pleung which is just the Thai translation of Lily. However, Witsarut works for her dad. So throughout the whole lakorn she's putting on all sorts of disguises as Lily so that he won't know Lily the boss' daughter is the same person as Plub Pleung.
title: Plub Plerng See Chompoo

overview: Wan is a spoiled young girl from a rich family with a grandmother, mother and two aunts. She never received love or care from her father since she was young and her mother always told her that her father was a bad man who left her mother to be with another wife. Wan has always disliked her father. Dom is the grandson of the eldest lady who is a maid in the house and they are respected by Wan's family because they have been there for a very long time. Wan and Dom grew up together and she loves to trick and tease him. However he seems to always tease her back, as both are strong headed towards each other. Once Wan graduated she entered the entertainment industry as her mother pleased and became a popular actress. She started to meet various men and was forced to spend some time with her father and stepmother.
title: Dao Lhong Fah

overview: Saenpoom returns quickly from overseas when he learns that his father, San, has died of a serious heart attack after vacationing on the beach with Maleewan. His young wife was just on vacation.
title: Nakak Dok Son Klin

overview: A joint Thai-American company builds a bridge across the Mekong River. Construction works disturbed the ancient inhabitant of those waters, namely the Serpent, which began to kill the workers. Dave Chon, at the request of the head of the company, comes to the site and tries to understand the situation. He helps Kim, who is doing research in that area. They go on an expedition to the Mekong, where they find a tribe living alone. Residents of the tribe told that the Serpent lives in a cave and protects treasures. This was learned by the military, who also equipped their expedition. As a result of their actions, the entrance through the caves to the tribe was blown up and Kim stayed there. Dave, completing the bridge and with hope in his heart, went in search of Kim. At the entrance to the cave, he encounters the Serpent. Will the ancient deity answer the pleas of Dave for help?
title: Mekong

overview: A story of a young dancer who allowed a ghost to possess her body in an exchange to save her father's life. The ghost uses her body to catch preys. She must endure the suffering of her bloody hands. When she meets a young officer and both fall in love with each other, but he will misunderstand that she is the one that killed his father but when in truth, it was the ghost that possessed her. A story that insinuate true love comes with sacrifice.
title: Sarb Dok Soi

overview: Thatri Thatriphan has gone bankrupt due to his extravagant spending and luxurious lifestyle. He has nothing, not even his house to his name. He doesn't even have anybody to rely on as both his lover and his friends have cut him off after he became bankrupt. One day while travelling by train, he chances to meet an old friend also named Thatri. This Thatri was once poor but has now become one of the heirs of a millionaire whose asset he is on his way to inherit.
title: The Two Faces of Thatri

overview: The popular improvisation show, hosted with a stunning lack of impartiality by Clive Anderson.
title: Whose Line Is It Anyway?

overview: Jack has everything to learn about becoming a parent, while his dad thinks he knows it all. Together, they set off to explore the meaning of fatherhood.
title: Jack Whitehall: Fatherhood with My Father

overview: Since the tragic death of her young son, acclaimed author Aggie Wiggs has receded from public life, unable to write, a ghost of her former self. But she finds an unlikely subject for a new book when the house next door is bought by Nile Jarvis, a famed and formidable real estate mogul who was once the prime suspect in his wife's disappearance. At once horrified and fascinated by this man, Aggie finds herself compulsively hunting for the truth – chasing his demons while fleeing her own – in a game of cat and mouse that might turn deadly.
title: The Beast in Me

overview: One day, an online novel about two people from two different worlds meeting through a mirror became the fascination of novel fans. However, it turns out to be based on Aksorn's life. Who is writing this story? How did the writer know Aksorn's personal story? It's the only clue that might lead him to reunite with the memories of the man from another parallel world. Follow the love story of two people across two different worlds and the miracles it entails.
title: Memory in the Letter

overview: For six weeks, the former tomboys will check in guests, clean rooms and work in the kitchen of a hotel near Moscow, and in their free time they will study entrepreneurship. Will the girls be able to keep their successful business afloat and how will the experiment of turning tomboys into businesswomen end?
title: Пацанки рулят

overview: S02 of https://www.tvmaze.com/shows/7592/mosgaz
title: Палач

overview: An HBO Max podcast for the Peacemaker show created by James Gunn. Hosts Ify Nwadiwe and Fiona Nova are here to guide you through the official, fan-driven companion podcast for HBO Max and DC's Peacemaker. They'll be sure to recap every laugh out loud moment, every kick ass action scene, and every tug on the heartstrings. And they'll be talking to some of the cast and creatives behind the show!
title: Podly: The Peacemaker Podcast

overview: Dr Charles Stanley, pastor of the First Baptist Church in Atlanta, shares his insights on Christian faith and enlightens viewers with spiritual motivation.
title: In Touch with Dr. Charles Stanley

overview: A documentary series about female cartoonists from all around the globe, challenging the red lines and taboos of their society. In search of people who experience their drawings in reality, they take us on a bold journey into their world.
title: Dessiner pour résister

overview: A kid-based sketch comedy, aimed at 9-16 year olds. It was a national spinoff of the already popular local show You Can't Do That on Television (YCDTOTV), which had debuted a few months earlier. Whatever Turns You On (WTYO) featured seven of the 22 kids used on the first season of YCDTOTV and was shot on the same sets. Essentially they were the same show, only WTYO had comedy and musical guests, and YCDTOTV had those plus local, call-in features, and local contests.
title: Whatever Turns You On

overview: Because of the loyalty to the company, which is embedded in blood and every cell of Massaya, she has to accept the role of assistant to Naan Fah, the young president of a chips company who is good-for-nothing. She has to help him salvage the company's sales within three months, otherwise, his chairman position might slip into the hands of others. A mission to reclaim the chairmanship is tough enough, but she must act as a nanny to control his behavior too, since he always goes astray if a pretty girl comes near. Because he is a lonesome boy, she has to act as his girlfriend, so that he will be in sight at all times. But he likes to flirt her a lot. Despite knowing that she should not fall in love with this fun-loving guy, her heart is shaken.
title: Pla Lhong Fah

overview: When the family inheritance is about to be taken over by greedy people. The two mill heir brothers rose up to fight. To protect the family and prove your worth.
title: Song Thoranong

overview: The main plot line of "Dok Bua Kao" is derived from a legend about a wealthy woman with a pure heart from centuries ago, who sacrificed all her worldly possessions to help the poor. She eventually dies out of starvation near a swamp. As legend goes, her body is then morphed into a lotus plant. In modern times, in buddhist culture, the lotus is used for worship for that reason, because it represents the highest order of sacrifice and purity. In "Dok Bua Kao", the lakorn, Oranoot is the embodiment of the ‘lotus' woman in modern times, she sacrifices everything for her family and gets nothing in return but heartache and pain.
title: Dok Bua Kao

overview: Phraphai is a skilled heart surgeon married to electrical engineer Din. The two have known each other since university and now have a three-year-old daughter named Namnile. Since becoming a wife and mother, Phraphai has little left over for romance. Din is a romantic. He wants time with his wife, but Phraphai isn't able to give it. In a drunken state, he slips up and sleeps with Frame. To Frame, however, it wasn't a mistake. She wants more. She plans ways to make Din break things off with his wife, but Phraphai is clever. She finds out what took place and gives Din an ultimatum, only further igniting Frame's fire. From there, a full-on war of love kicks off.
title: Dancing Flames

overview: Prot is a kind man who lost his memory. He is enlisted to continue acting as the heir of a wealthy family by Paron the real heir, to help find evidence of the betrayal going on inside and outside of the company. Although he is not used to being a hiso, he makes the best of it. Everyone adores him for being a good person while Naet, the fiancee of real Paron also begins to like him and their love begins to bloom.
title: Jao Sua Mua Nim

overview: An ill-fated love story between Chud, a high ranking soldier and Bua, a slave. He's wealthy. She's poor. He's of high status. She and her father are indebted. Therefore, she becomes the collateral to their debtor as a slave. They are two worlds apart, but that doesn't stop them from developing feelings for each other. Many years later, the two lovers from the past find each other again in the present and the next chapter starts...
title: Buang Wan Wan

overview: Join Mister Maker and get ready for an arty party!
title: Mister Maker's Arty Party

overview: Selena + Restaurant takes the next step in her culinary adventure as she heads out of her home kitchen and into the professional kitchens of some of LA's hottest restaurants. Gomez will be accompanied by best friend, Raquelle Stevens, as her cooking skills are put to the test by the best in the business. Chefs will teach and test Selena to see how quickly she can learn the ropes with the ultimate goal of creating a dish good enough to make each restaurant's menu. Each chef will also highlight a charity that is meaningful to them during each episode, with all of the featured non-profits receiving a donation to further their cause.
title: Selena + Restaurant

overview: A handsome New Orleans detective and a sexy district attorney heat things up in New Orleans, The Big Easy, as the two investigate crimes in a beleaguered police department.
title: The Big Easy

overview: When Ma Zhuo was 8 years old, he was brought to live with Linjiang by his mother Lin Guoguo. He met his neighbor's brother Xia Ze, and the two became childhood sweethearts and gradually fell in love. After graduating from high school, they went in both directions and made a private decision, regardless of their parents' opposition and the barriers of being in another place. Unexpectedly, Ma Zhuo's mother Lin Guoguo died suddenly at this time, and Xia Ze's father Xia Gang was listed as the main suspect, and his whereabouts are unknown. Ma Zhuo and Xia Ze's identities changed from lovers to "daughters of victims" and "sons of suspects", and they broke up painfully and decisively. A few years later, Ma Zhuo, who became an excellent lawyer, returned to Linjiang and met Xia Ze again. The two of them pursued the truth about their fathers together in dangers and thorns, and at the same time fell into a moving sadomasochism that broke out and combined.
title: The Farewell Song

overview: During the Anti-Japanese War, the Japanese army, aiming to smoothly occupy Changsha, activated a strategic spy known as "Black Butler" who had been undercover in China for 15 years, to carry out a long-planned strategic deception. A Communist Party underground member, Yun Muzhi, was killed in the process of investigating "Black Butler." His son, Yun Hongshen, unknowingly of his father's true identity, pursued the murderer and was caught in a trap already set by "Black Butler." In times of confusion and helplessness, a close friend of his father provided him with significant assistance and protection, allowing him to finally see through the adversary's schemes. Under the leadership of the Communist Party, Yun Hongshen joined forces with the patriotic youth Wen Yeming, setting traps within traps, advancing cautiously, putting aside personal vendettas in the face of national hatred, setting himself up as a sacrifice to uncover the Japanese strategic spies hidden within the Nationalist army, turning the tide of the war, and making a significant contribution to the victory of the first Battle of Changsha.
title: Deep Lurk

overview: It tells the story of detectives Jiang Guangming and Shi Luo who accidentally discover that the crime scene depicted in a novel by writer Gu Jiming coincides with the case they are investigating… Fiction and reality intertwine, as the novel both guides them and plunges them deeper into the mystery… In this convoluted enigma, who is the murderer behind the scenes?
title: Interlaced Scenes

overview: Xiao Chang Qing, Sun Qian Cheng and Chen Xin Cheng worked hard all their lives. After retirement, they finally got together and co-founded a warm retirement community. In the community, they solved problems that elderly people faced, and in the process, they recognized their own problems and reconciled with their family and with themselves
title: Golden Trio

overview: In the legendary Nine Cities, Fan Yun, a poor young lady from a distinguished family, and Qi Zheng, the lord of Bai Qie Hei City, progress from testing each other to mutual trust. Together, they overcome obstacles for the people's benefit, ultimately finding both friendship and love; Fan Yun also helps Qi Zheng to bring peace to the realm, break old conventions, resolve the crisis of the Nine Cities, and work together to build a prosperous Nine Cities. The series is adapted from Saori Yukino's "The Tale of the Kingdom of Clouds."
title: The Legend of Rosy Clouds

overview: Han Qing is a cop in the Sanhe Criminal Investigation Team. Known for her serious demeanor and focus on work, she is nicknamed "Unhappy." She has a strong partnership with her colleague, Zhong Wei, with whom she has worked for many years. However, Zhong Wei goes missing after tracking a suspect, and it has been nearly two months since she has heard from him. Amid the anxiety and frustration, Han Qing deals with other cases while not giving up any clues related to Zhong Wei. A newly emerged murder case catches Han Qing's attention, leading her to suspect that it is linked to Zhong Wei's disappearance. Despite countless obstacles in the investigation, the true culprit eventually surfaces, and what Zhong Wei has been through gradually becomes clear. Unraveling the links between the three major cases of disappearance, murder, and drug trafficking, the police uncover a meticulously organized network of criminal groups and the secrets hidden behind it. The Sanhe Criminal Investigation Team work together to solve the entire case in one fell swoop, capturing all the criminals involved.
title: Breaking the Shadows

overview: One night, Yu Hao, a college student who was at his wits' end, had an unexpected encounter with a mysterious visitor – "General" – who had a dream travelled. He led Yu Hao in solving the countless riddles that abounded in the realm of the conscious and lit up the fire beacons on the meandering Great Wall. Thereafter, the darkness retreated, the sun rose, and when the long night was thoroughly lit up, the him who existed, in reality, was reborn. The black dragon that roared, the lighthouse and demonic eye on the coastline, the rain forest before Chichén Itzá, the fierce beasts that wreaked havoc in the Colosseum…the bizarre projection of reality in one's consciousness reflected the hidden place that the sunlight, in reality, couldn't touch – the innumerable sins of the human heart. The journey of seizing dreams continues, and one can only hope that the sun will continue illuminating the human heart. Fire beacons on the Great Wall were lit up to signal a border invasion. (Source: Book's synopsis) Adapted from the novel "Seizing Dreams" (夺梦) by Fei Tian Ye Xiang (非天夜翔)
title: Dreamcatcher

overview: The drama is adapted from the novel "The Meridian Gate" by Ying Zhao. It tells the story of Qi Chun Jiao, an athletic girl who unexpectedly transforms into Gu Qingqiao, the daughter of a tavern owner in ancient times. Alongside Duan Yu, Lu Zizheng, Ruan Siqiong, and others, she embarks on a time-traveling adventure to seek out spirits and treasure. Ultimately, they find familial love, romantic love, and friendship, reconcile with their imperfect selves, and discover their life direction in this light-hearted, romantic, and inspirational story.
title: Her Fantastic Adventures

overview: Dick Turpin is a British television drama series starring Richard O'Sullivan and Michael Deeks. It was created by Richard Carpenter, Paul Knight and Sydney Cole and written by Richard Carpenter, John Kane, Charles Crichton and Paul Wheeler, it was made by Gatetarn, Seacastle productions in-association with London Weekend Television between 1979 and 1982. 26 half hour episodes and one feature-length episode were filmed on location at Maidenhead in Berkshire, England. The series is loosely based on the adventures of the real 18th century highwayman Dick Turpin.
title: Dick Turpin

overview: The Rhyme Rocket is an interstellar journey aimed at introducing children to a universe full of words where they can discover a range of laugh out loud poems and rhymes. The series will follow the cosmic adventures of First Officer Ditty, Professor Poet and Commander Rhyme-a-lot as they blast through space on a mission to collect poetry and songs from around the universe "one rhyme at a time."
title: The Rhyme Rocket

overview: In the UK alone, an estimated 10 million people suffer with a phobia. From emetophobia (a chronic fear of vomit) to arachnophobia (a fear of spiders), musophobia (a fear of mice), ranidophobia (a fear of frogs) and even globophobia (a severe phobia of balloons). Often, deep-rooted in past experiences or traumas, these phobias can cause shame, stigma and even ridicule as people suffer in silence, sometimes with wide-ranging, negative impacts on their daily lives. Filmed on fixed-rig cameras, in each episode of The Fear Clinic, three British phobia sufferers check into the state-of-the-art clinic in Amsterdam, where a renowned Dutch scientist and her team of psychologists will treat their phobias.
title: The Fear Clinic: Face Your Phobia

overview: Westside Medical follows three dedicated young physicians in a Southern California clinic.
title: Westside Medical

overview: Embark on an epic journey through brutally harsh landscapes and step inside the lairs of Australia and Africa's most extreme snakes.
title: Extreme Snakes

overview: Zoya Neupokoeva is successful, assertive, and self—confident. One day, she makes an offer to her boss, a successful lawyer Roman. But in the end, she remains without a beloved man, and without a job. And soon trouble comes to her family — Zoya's tribesmen disappear without a trace. Trying to figure out this complicated case, she turns for help to investigator Denis, whom she once intended to marry, but fled to Moscow to make a career as an investigator. And now Zoya realizes that she made a big mistake in her youth.
title: Неукротимая Неупокоева

overview: A childish and rude life-changing comic melodrama in which announcer Song Ki-baek meets passionate entertainment writer On Woo-joo.
title: Frankly Speaking
